seo.description: Calculate copper busbar, sheet, and bar weight. Copper density is 8960 kg/m³.

formula.explanation: Weight = L × W × T × ρ. Copper density = 8960 kg/m³. For busbars and electrical conductors.

content.introduction: Calculate copper weight for busbars, electrical conductors, sheets, and copper parts. Copper density is 8960 kg/m³ — heavier than steel but with superior electrical conductivity.

faq.a: Pure copper is 8960 kg/m³. Brass is 8500 kg/m³, bronze is 8800 kg/m³.

faq.q: How do I size a copper busbar?
faq.a: Busbar sizing depends on current carrying capacity (amps). As a rule of thumb, 1A per mm² of cross-section is conservative for continuous duty.
